description_expanded:
30a Beach Properties presents the Crown Penthouse. This 58 Main St Rosemary Beach location offers fabulous gulf, western green and sunset views. This rare south Main St address is steps to restaurants and the beach. A perfect location for easy family beach access or attending a wedding. New interiors by local professional designer feature soft natural fabrics and crisp clean bedding in a refreshing beach design that will invite you to relax with family and friends! At 1500 sf, the Crown Penthouse occupies the entire 3rd and 4th floors of 58 Main Street. Over 400 sqft of private balconies provide spectacular Rosemary Beach views and gulf breezes.

We provide passes to access all 4 Rosemary Beach Community pools, and any of the 9 Beach Walkovers

All towels, bed linens, blankets, comforters, and pillow/mattress protectors are professionally laundered for every new reservation!

3rd floor: The spacious kitchen/dining/living floorplan opens to the 3rd floor balcony overlooking Main Street & Western Green. Bedroom 2 has its own private sunset balcony.

4th floor: The inviting master bedroom suite and lovely bath feature a sunset terrace that overlooks the homes and rooftops of Rosemary Beach.

Master: King, private bath and balcony

BR 2: Queen, bath and balcony

Bunk: cozy built in (adjacent to ling room on main floor)

Fully equipped kitchen, breakfast bar, and comfortable dining area featuring travertine flooring.

Note: No elevator, stairs only. One reserved parking space.

The roof sunset terrace and balconies open to the panoramic glittering Gulf waters.

The Barbados pool and Coquina Pool (heated) are nearby. Boardwalk 'G' is steps away. Two entrances from Main St or West entrance provide easy, clean stair access.

Features

•One reserved parking space plus off street parking

•Fully-equipped kitchen

•New furnishings, bedding in an upscale look

•Wireless Internet, flat panel TVs

•Washer/dryer

•Iron and board

We look forward to hosting you!
